jobs.title: Walk-Thru Sales Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
$90K–$105K OTE • Uncapped commission • Full benefits + equity • LA field role

The opportunity

You'll spend your days inside beautiful LA homes, having genuine conversations with homeowners about a service that genuinely makes their lives better. No cold calls. No fighting for attention. Every prospect you meet is a warm, pre-qualified lead who's eager to hear how Honey Homes works.

Your job: show them what stress-free homeownership actually looks like, and help them say yes.

About Honey Homes

Honey Homes is a membership service for homeowners that takes care of the everyday to-do's, ongoing maintenance, and unexpected repairs that come with owning a home. Members are paired with a dedicated handyperson and use a simple app to coordinate. We're on a mission to replace the hassle of homeownership with the joy of comfortable living.

We're backed by Khosla Ventures, Era Ventures, Pear.vc, and the co-founders of DoorDash, Lyft, and Opendoor. Our team has built and scaled companies like Airbnb, Google, Opendoor, Yelp, Zillow, and Uber.

What you'll do

Every homeowner considering Honey Homes starts with a free in-home walk-thru, the most important step in our sales process. You'll run those visits.

In about 45 minutes, you'll walk the home with the prospective member, educate them on how the membership works, answer their questions, and capture their first 10+ tasks directly in our app. Your goal is to help them book their first handyman visit before you leave, and set that visit up to be a great one.

You'll do 5–6 walk-thru's a day, Monday through Friday, across the LA area. The playbook is proven and we've spent three years refining it, so you're stepping into something that works. Your job is to execute it brilliantly and make it your own.

Why this role is different

  • Warm leads only. Homeowners book the walk-thru themselves. You're not chasing anyone.

  • You're in their home. This is high-trust, in-person selling. If you've ever been frustrated by Zoom or phone sales, this will feel like a breath of fresh air.

  • Uncapped earnings. Top performers earn well above the OTE range and have a clear path into other roles at the company.

  • You sell something people actually want. Homeownership is stressful. We fix that. Every member you sign up genuinely benefits.

  • Real career upside. This isn't a dead-end SDR seat. Top performers move into senior roles as we grow.

  • Flexible engagement options. We're open to contract-to-hire and part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

  • Get in early in a growing market. LA is one of our newer markets, which means more opportunity to shape how we show up here and grow with it.

What we're looking for

You can sell. You have 4+ years of sales experience in high-performance environments, likely at a startup or in home services. You know how to read a room, handle objections in real time, and ask for the close.

You're a strong communicator. Excellent verbal and written skills. You're comfortable and confident in someone else's living room.

You build relationships fast. You're energized by people. You read them well, you're empathetic, and you make them feel heard.

You know your way around a home. You don't need to be a handyman, but you should understand the basics of plumbing, electrical, carpentry, and home systems. Maybe you're a homeowner yourself, or you grew up tinkering. Either way, you can talk credibly about what a membership covers.

You know LA. You're comfortable driving across the area, you know the neighborhoods, and traffic doesn't intimidate you.

You have a growth mindset. You'll follow a proven playbook, and you'll also push to make it better. Ambiguity doesn't faze you. Rapid change at a startup excites you.

You're relentless. Sales has up days and down days. You bounce back fast and keep moving.

You document everything. You sweat the details, track your progress, and keep your teammates in the loop.

You act like an owner. You do right by our members and your teammates, especially when it's hard.

What success looks like in 90 days

  • Walk-thru conversion rate is up. You prepare thoroughly for every visit and deliver consistently strong walk-thru's. A meaningfully higher percentage of prospective members sign up.

  • Your team is set up to win on every lead. Marketing and inside sales are your partners, and this role also carries a self-generated component: roughly 70% of leads are warm, and 30% are self-sourced.

  • Every first handyman visit is a great one. Your detailed notes, task lists, and internal handoffs make sure new members start their membership thrilled.

Compensation and benefits

  • On-target earnings: $90,000–$105,000 ($70 000 Base). Uncapped, with real upside for top performers.

  • Equity. Every employee is an owner at Honey Homes.

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision for employees.

  • 401(k), FSA, paid parental leave, and a flexible time-off policy.

A few things to know

This is a field role based in the Los Angeles area. You'll need a reliable vehicle, a valid driver's license, and a willingness to drive throughout the region.

If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to meet you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. Women and under-represented minorities are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Member Operations Associate (Oakland)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Honey Homes

Honey Homes is reimagining homeownership through a membership that makes maintaining a home effortless. Our members have a dedicated handyman who proactively cares for their home year-round, helping prevent small problems from becoming expensive ones.

The Member Operations Associate is the evolution of traditional customer support. Rather than simply responding to members, you'll own member outcomes while helping improve the systems, tools, and processes that power the entire member experience.

Every day you'll work directly with homeowners, helping them solve problems and coordinating across teams to ensure they're taken care of. But that's only part of the job. You'll also identify recurring issues, improve workflows, leverage AI to eliminate repetitive work, and partner across the business to make Honey Homes better for both our members and our internal teams.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys helping people, loves solving problems, thinks in systems rather than one-off solutions, and is excited about using AI and technology to fundamentally change how customer operations are run.

This is a hybrid role based in our Oakland headquarters (4 days/week in office).

Please note the shift for this role is Sunday - Thursday.

What You'll Do

Own the member journey

Own member issues from beginning to end across app messaging, phone, SMS, and email. You'll coordinate across teams, communicate proactively, remove blockers, and ensure every member feels taken care of throughout their experience. Solving the immediate problem is expected. Owning the outcome is the standard.

Solve today's problems while eliminating tomorrow's

Every recurring member issue should trigger a deeper question: Why did this happen? How do we prevent it? Can we automate it? Should we document it? Does another team need to know? Your job isn't complete when the ticket is resolved. It's complete when you've helped reduce the likelihood another member experiences the same problem.

Use AI to multiply your impact

Leverage AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to eliminate repetitive work, improve documentation, automate workflows, and increase your effectiveness. We expect everyone on the team to actively experiment with new tools, test ideas, and continuously improve how work gets done.

Improve the member experience

Member Success sits at the center of the member experience. You'll partner closely with Sales, Walkthrough Specialists, Field Operations, Billing, Product, Marketing, Recruiting, and other teams to surface trends, advocate for change, and help implement better ways of working. Our responsibility is the entire member journey, not just the conversations that reach our queue.

Own a functional area

In addition to supporting members, every Member Operations Associate owns an area of the business. This might include onboarding, messaging, knowledge management, phone operations, AI tools, NPS, reporting, documentation, or another operational focus area. You'll become the team's subject matter expert and be responsible for continuously improving how that area operates over time.

Operate with high agency

We don't wait for someone else to identify problems. We expect every teammate to proactively find opportunities, propose solutions, build improvements, measure their impact, and share what they've learned. Curiosity, ownership, systems thinking, and continuous improvement aren't nice-to-haves—they're core expectations of the role.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you'll:

  • Deliver consistently exceptional experiences for Honey Homes members.

  • Develop expertise in your operational ownership area and drive measurable improvements.

  • Identify recurring member issues and help implement solutions that reduce future support volume.

  • Build AI-powered workflows and automations that improve efficiency across the team.

  • Create documentation, SOPs, and knowledge resources that make the organization more effective.

  • Become a trusted cross-functional partner who proactively identifies opportunities to improve operations and follows through on delivering results.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for people who care deeply about helping customers but are equally motivated to improve the systems behind the customer experience.

The strongest candidates will bring many of the following:

  • 2+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, operations, hospitality, or another customer-facing role.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • High agency and a bias toward ownership - you don't wait to be asked to solve problems.

  • Curiosity and a desire to continuously improve how work gets done.

  • Comfort learning and using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies to improve productivity.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • The ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams.

  • An interest in process improvement, operational excellence, and building scalable systems.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment is a plus.

The compensation for this role is $72,000 plus equity. Because it's part of a structured program, we offer the same compensation package to everyone in the program and therefore is non-negotiable.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. Women and under-represented minorities are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Honey Homes

Honey Homes makes homeownership effortless. We proactively handle members’ everyday to-dos, ongoing maintenance, and surprise repairs by pairing each member with a dedicated handyperson and a simple app to coordinate it all. Our mission is to replace hassle and stress with the joy of comfortable living, and we’re building the technology to make that magic happen at scale.

We’re growing fast, serving over 3,000 happy members, and backed by top investors including Khosla Ventures, Pear VC, and the co-founders of DoorDash, Lyft, and Opendoor.

The role

As one of the first engineers on the team, you’ll have outsized ownership and impact. You’ll shape the foundation of Honey Homes’ technology, from our member and handyperson apps to the internal platform (“Honey Homes OS”) that powers our nationwide operations. You’ll have the chance to influence product direction, architecture, and engineering culture from day one.

We’re looking for a thoughtful, full-stack generalist who loves taking ownership of big, ambiguous problems and shipping elegant solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with teammates across the company to create the seamless experience that defines Honey Homes.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in small, high-trust teams, where decisions are fast, ideas turn into features in days, and your work directly affects thousands of members’ daily lives.

This role is fully remote, with the option to work from our Oakland, CA headquarters.

About you

  • You’re an experienced full-stack developer. You’ve built and shipped meaningful products across the stack. Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Docker, TypeScript, Google Cloud, or React will help you contribute immediately, but ability and excitement to quickly learn is much more important to us.

  • You’re a self-starter and act as an owner. You’re excited to own critical features of our product, and have thrived in environments with a large amount of responsibility and autonomy before. (Bonus points for being a previous founder or early employee at a rapidly-growing startup.)

  • You’re energized by ambiguity and complexity. We are a fast-moving startup tackling complicated problems, and you’ve been successful on similar teams. You have the ability to independently balance speed and scrappiness with long-term technical excellence.

  • You have a growth mindset and are motivated to learn and improve your craft in this role. (Bonus points for passion about home maintenance and improvement.)

6-month outcomes

  • Help improve response quality, speed, and messaging across the funnel

  • Contribute ideas that increase booked walk-thrus and lead conversion

2. Expand local awareness through events and field marketing

You handle rejection well, maintain a positive attitude, and continue showing up with energy and persistence.

You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy feedback, adapt quickly, and are excited to wear multiple hats as the company grows.

We’re seeking a motivated, high-energy operator who enjoys people-facing work and thrives in fast-moving environments.

Ideal backgrounds include:

  • SDR / BDR experience

  • Appointment setting or phone sales

  • Customer-facing startup experience

  • Comfortable working weekends and attending field events

  • Comfortable traveling throughout the Bay Area for field work and activations

Home services experience is a plus, but not required.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
$90K–$105K OTE ($70,000 Base) • Uncapped commission • Full benefits + equity • San Jose Field Role

The opportunity

You'll spend your days inside beautiful Bay Area homes, having genuine conversations with homeowners about a service that genuinely makes their lives better. No cold calls. No fighting for attention. Every prospect you meet is a warm, pre-qualified lead who's eager to hear how Honey Homes works.

Your job: show them what stress-free homeownership actually looks like, and help them say yes.

About Honey Homes

Honey Homes is a membership service for homeowners that takes care of the everyday to-do's, ongoing maintenance, and unexpected repairs that come with owning a home. Members are paired with a dedicated handyperson and use a simple app to coordinate. We're on a mission to replace the hassle of homeownership with the joy of comfortable living.

We're backed by Khosla Ventures, Era Ventures, Pear.vc, and the co-founders of DoorDash, Lyft, and Opendoor. Our team has built and scaled companies like Airbnb, Google, Opendoor, Yelp, Zillow, and Uber.

What you'll do

Every homeowner considering Honey Homes starts with a free in-home walk-thru, the most important step in our sales process. You'll run those visits.

In about 45 minutes, you'll walk the home with the prospective member, educate them on how the membership works, answer their questions, and capture their first 10+ tasks directly in our app. Your goal is to help them book their first handyman visit before you leave, and set that visit up to be a great one.

You'll do 5–6 walk-thru's a day, Monday through Friday, in the San Jose area. The playbook is proven and we've spent three years refining it, so you're stepping into something that works. Your job is to execute it brilliantly and make it your own.

Why this role is different

  • You're in their home. This is high-trust, in-person selling. If you've ever been frustrated by Zoom or phone sales, this will feel like a breath of fresh air.

  • Uncapped earnings. Top performers earn well above the OTE range and have a clear path into other roles at the company.

  • You sell something people actually want. Homeownership is stressful. We fix that. Every member you sign up genuinely benefits.

  • Real career upside. This isn't a dead-end SDR seat. Top performers move into senior roles as we grow.

What we're looking for

You can sell. You have 4+ years of sales experience in high-performance environments, likely at a startup or in home services. You know how to read a room, handle objections in real time, and ask for the close.

You're a strong communicator. Excellent verbal and written skills. You're comfortable and confident in someone else's living room.

You build relationships fast. You're energized by people. You read them well, you're empathetic, and you make them feel heard.

You know your way around a home. You don't need to be a handyman, but you should understand the basics of plumbing, electrical, carpentry, and home systems. Maybe you're a homeowner yourself, or you grew up tinkering. Either way, you can talk credibly about what a membership covers.

You have a growth mindset. You'll follow a proven playbook, and you'll also push to make it better. Ambiguity doesn't faze you. Rapid change at a startup excites you.

You're relentless. Sales has up days and down days. You bounce back fast and keep moving.

You document everything. You sweat the details, track your progress, and keep your teammates in the loop.

You act like an owner. You do right by our members and your teammates, especially when it's hard.

What success looks like in 90 days

  • Walk-thru conversion rate is up. You prepare thoroughly for every visit and deliver consistently strong walk-thru's. A meaningfully higher percentage of prospective members sign up.

  • Your team is set up to win on every lead. Marketing and inside sales are your partners, and this role also carries a self-generated component: roughly 70% of leads are warm, and 30% are self-sourced.

  • Every first handyman visit is a great one. Your detailed notes, task lists, and internal handoffs make sure new members start their membership thrilled.

Compensation and benefits

  • On-target earnings: $90,000–$105,000 ($70, 000 Base). Uncapped, with real upside for top performers.

  • Equity. Every employee is an owner at Honey Homes.

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision for employees.

  • 401(k), FSA, paid parental leave, and a flexible time-off policy.

A few things to know

This is a field role based in the San Jose area. You'll need a reliable vehicle, a valid driver's license, and a willingness to drive throughout the region.

If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to meet you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. Women and under-represented minorities are encouraged to apply.

About Honey Homes

Honey Homes is a membership service for homeowners that takes care of the everyday to-do's, ongoing maintenance, and unexpected repairs that come with owning a home. Members are paired with a dedicated handyperson and use a simple app to coordinate. We're on a mission to replace the hassle of homeownership with the joy of comfortable living.

We're backed by Khosla Ventures, Era Ventures, Pear.vc, and the co-founders of DoorDash, Lyft, and Opendoor. Our team has built and scaled companies like Airbnb, Google, Opendoor, Yelp, Zillow, and Uber.

 

The Opportunity

You’ll spend your days inside beautiful homes, helping existing Honey Homes members get the most out of one of their Honey Homes Membership. Every renewal begins with an in-home Renewal Consultation, one of the most important moments in the member journey. This isn’t a sales call. It’s an opportunity to build trust, assess the health of the home, celebrate everything that’s been accomplished, and help homeowners plan what’s next.

Your job is to leave every member feeling confident that Honey Homes is the right long-term partner for their home.

What You’ll Do

Every member approaching renewal receives an in-home Renewal Consultation.

Over the course of about 90 minutes, you’ll walk the home with the member, complete a comprehensive home health assessment, identify maintenance opportunities, answer questions, and build a thoughtful plan for the year ahead. You’ll review the value they’ve received, recommend future projects, and help them choose the membership that best fits their needs.

You’ll also capture photos, document recommendations, build scopes of work, and coordinate with our operations team so every follow-up visit is set up for success.

Every home is different. Every conversation is different. The common thread is helping homeowners feel informed, cared for, and excited about what’s next.

Why This Role Is Different

You’re building relationships—not making cold calls.

Every homeowner you meet is already a Honey Homes member. They know us, trust us, and are inviting you into their home to help them make smart decisions about its care.

You become their trusted home advisor.

This isn’t transactional sales. You’ll educate homeowners, uncover needs they may not recognize, and help them proactively protect one of their biggest investments.

Every day is different.

Every home tells a different story. You’ll encounter unique maintenance challenges, meet fascinating homeowners, and help create personalized plans that make homeownership easier.

You have real ownership.

You’ll have meaningful influence over one of the most important moments in the member lifecycle. Your work directly impacts member satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

Help shape the future of the program.

Our Renewal Consultation program is still evolving. Your feedback from the field will directly influence how we improve the experience, our technology, and the playbook over time.

Join early and grow with us.

Honey Homes is still early. As we continue to expand, top performers will have opportunities to help shape our member experience, operations, and future teams.

What We’re Looking For

You’re naturally consultative.

You enjoy helping people make thoughtful decisions. You ask great questions, listen carefully, explain complex topics simply, and create confidence without pressure.

You build trust quickly.

You’re comfortable walking into someone’s home and making them feel at ease within minutes. Homeowners naturally see you as someone they can rely on.

You know your way around a home.

You don’t need to be a licensed contractor, but you understand the basics of home maintenance and enjoy helping homeowners prioritize projects. You’re curious, practical, and eager to keep learning.

You’re highly organized.

Great recommendations are only valuable if they’re documented well. You capture detailed notes, thoughtful scopes of work, photos, and next steps that allow the rest of the organization to execute seamlessly.

You notice what others miss.

You have an eye for detail and enjoy identifying opportunities before they become expensive problems. Whether it’s deferred maintenance, safety concerns, or future improvements, you’re always thinking a few steps ahead.

You’re energized by startups.

You enjoy building as much as operating. You’ll follow a proven playbook, but you’ll also help improve it. You’re excited by ambiguity and constantly looking for better ways to work.

You act like an owner.

You care deeply about delivering an exceptional member experience. You take responsibility for the outcome—not just the appointment—and consistently look for ways to improve both the member experience and the business.

What Success Looks Like in 12 Months

Members renew because they trust you.

Your Renewal Consultations consistently leave members feeling informed, cared for, and excited about continuing their membership. Renewal conversion rates and member satisfaction are among the strongest in the company.

Every home has a clear plan.

Your assessments identify meaningful maintenance opportunities, prioritize future work, and ensure members leave every consultation with a thoughtful roadmap for the year ahead.

The operation runs better because of your work.

Your documentation, photos, scopes of work, and recommendations enable Scheduling, Field Operations, and Member Success to execute seamlessly with minimal rework.

Members get more value from Honey Homes.

You help homeowners fully utilize their membership by proactively identifying projects, scheduling future work before leaving the home, and ensuring they understand all the ways Honey Homes can help.

The Renewal Consultation program keeps improving.

You continuously share feedback from the field, identify recurring themes, and help evolve the playbook, technology, and member experience as Honey Homes grows.

Compensation and benefits

  • Salary of $86,000.

  • Equity. Every employee is an owner at Honey Homes.

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision for employees.

  • 401(k), FSA, paid parental leave, and a flexible time-off policy.

A few things to know

This is a field role based in the SF Bay Area area. You'll need a reliable vehicle, a valid driver's license, and a willingness to drive throughout the region.

If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Honey Homes

Honey Homes is reimagining homeownership through a membership that makes maintaining a home effortless. Our members have a dedicated handyman who proactively cares for their home year-round, helping prevent small problems from becoming expensive ones.

The Manager of Member Success owns the day-to-day performance of our Member Success organization while building the systems, tools, and processes that allow us to deliver an exceptional member experience at scale.

This is a hands-on operational leadership role. Your first responsibility is ensuring that every member message is answered, every issue is moving toward resolution, and our team consistently delivers against its service-level and quality goals. You'll manage staffing, coach teammates, monitor performance, and maintain the operational discipline required to run a high-performing support organization.

But running today's operation is only half the job. You'll also be responsible for fundamentally improving how Member Success works. You'll lead AI automation efforts, develop dashboards and tools that make our team more effective, and own strategic initiatives across a variety of operational workflows to improve member outcomes and business outcomes.

We're looking for someone who combines relentless operational execution with the ability to build systems that make the operation dramatically better. You should be equally comfortable jumping into a member escalation, managing an underperforming teammate, analyzing support data, and building a new workflow that eliminates hundreds of future conversations.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage exclusively through delegation. You'll be close to the work, accountable for the details, and expected to continuously improve the organization you're running.

This is a hybrid role based in our Oakland headquarters (4 days/week in office).

What You'll Do

Own the daily performance of Member Success

You're accountable for ensuring that every incoming member message is answered each day and that our team consistently delivers fast, thoughtful, and accurate support. Own queue management, response times, service-level agreements, quality standards, and escalation handling. Develop the daily operating rhythms, accountability, and visibility needed to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

Lead and develop a high-performing team

Own staffing, scheduling, hiring, coaching, and performance management for our Member Success team. Ensure we have the right coverage throughout the week, establish clear expectations, and hold teammates accountable for results. Build a culture of urgency, ownership, and continuous improvement while developing teammates who can independently solve complex member problems.

Use AI and data to transform our operations

Lead our efforts to automate member support through Sherlock, our AI-powered member assistant, and other emerging tools. Build dashboards and AI-powered workflows that improve visibility, identify operational bottlenecks, and increase team productivity. Partner with Product and Engineering to expand automation capabilities while maintaining an exceptional member experience.

Own renewals and member retention

Build and continuously improve our membership renewal process. Ensure members receive proactive, timely outreach, identify at-risk members before they churn, and develop scalable workflows that improve retention. Own the operating model, performance metrics, and execution of renewals across the team.

Build proactive member engagement systems

Lead our efforts to move from reactive support to proactive member engagement. Develop and improve our member engagement process, using member behavior, lifecycle milestones, and operational signals to trigger timely outreach and interventions. Build systems that anticipate member needs, improve engagement, and prevent problems before they occur.

Scale and improve handyman transitions

Own the process of transitioning members between handymen, ensuring a seamless experience that preserves trust and continuity of service. Build scalable workflows, communication strategies, and operational processes that allow us to manage transitions efficiently as we grow. Partner closely with Field Operations to coordinate transitions, minimize disruption, and ensure members feel supported throughout the process.

Develop policies and strengthen operational discipline

Build the policies, processes, and operating standards that allow Member Success to make consistent, high-quality decisions. Identify areas where policies are unclear or underdeveloped, such as roof work and other service limitations, and work cross-functionally to establish clear guidelines. Ensure policies are documented, communicated, and consistently followed.

Build seamless third-party and referral experiences

Own the processes that connect members with third-party service providers when their needs extend beyond Honey Homes' core capabilities. Explore integrations with third parties and other service providers to create scalable, technology-enabled workflows. Develop solutions that make these experiences seamless for members while reducing manual coordination for our team.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you'll:

  • Run an exceptional daily operation. Ensure every incoming member message is answered each day, maintain a healthy support queue, and consistently achieve our service-level, response-time, and quality goals.

  • Build a high-performing team. Establish effective staffing models, clear performance expectations, consistent coaching, and strong hiring practices. Develop a team that operates with urgency, accountability, and excellent judgment.

  • Increase productivity through AI. Expand Sherlock's capabilities, automate repetitive workflows, and build tools that allow the team to support more members without proportional increases in headcount.

  • Create operational visibility. Develop dashboards and reporting that make queue health, response times, team performance, member satisfaction, and automation effectiveness easy to understand and act upon.

  • Improve member retention. Build a proactive, measurable renewal process that improves retention, strengthens member relationships, and reduces preventable churn.

  • Launch scalable proactive engagement. Develop and operationalize our member engagement state machine, enabling timely, personalized interventions based on member behavior and lifecycle milestones.

  • Scale handyman transitions. Build repeatable workflows for transitioning members between handymen, reducing manual effort and disruption while maintaining member trust and satisfaction.

  • Strengthen operational discipline. Establish clear policies, SOPs, and escalation protocols that reduce ambiguity and improve consistency across the organization.

  • Improve third-party service coordination. Develop scalable workflows and integrations that make it easier for members to access third-party services without unnecessary friction.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an exceptional operator who knows how to run a high-performing customer organization while building the systems that make it better.

The strongest candidates will bring many of the following:

  • 8+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, operations, or a related field, including meaningful people management experience.

  • A demonstrated track record of running high-volume customer operations with rigorous queue management, staffing, performance monitoring, and service-level accountability.

  • Experience hiring, coaching, developing, and managing performance across customer-facing teams.

  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail. You build systems that ensure important work gets done consistently, every day.

  • Strong analytical skills, including experience building dashboards, monitoring KPIs, and using data to identify and solve operational problems.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, automation, or workflow technologies to improve operational efficiency.

  • A track record of building and implementing projects that deliver meaningful, measurable improvements to business operations.

  • Excellent judgment when balancing customer needs, company policies, operational constraints, and business outcomes.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when handling complex or emotionally charged customer situations.

  • High agency, urgency, and personal accountability. You don't wait to be asked to solve problems.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities change, resources are limited, and execution matters.

  • A willingness to get into the details, do the work yourself when necessary, and lead by example.

Why This Role Is Different

Most customer support management roles focus on running an existing operation.

At Honey Homes, you'll be responsible for running the operation exceptionally well while fundamentally changing how it works.

We believe the best Member Success organizations combine rigorous daily execution with continuous operational improvement. Every member deserves a fast, thoughtful response today. But every recurring issue is also an opportunity to build a better system for tomorrow.

You'll lead a team that is increasingly empowered by AI, build proactive engagement systems that anticipate member needs, and help create an organization that delivers a better experience as it scales.

If you're energized by operational excellence, love developing great people, and get excited about building systems that make entire organizations more effective, we'd love to meet you.

Your first responsibility is ensuring that every member message is answered, every issue is moving toward resolution, and our team consistently delivers against its service-level and quality goals. You'll manage staffing, coach teammates, monitor performance, and maintain the operational discipline required to run a high-performing support organization.

But running today's operation is only half the job. You'll also be responsible for fundamentally improving how Member Success works. You'll lead AI automation efforts, develop dashboards and tools that make our team more effective, and own strategic initiatives across a variety of operational workflows to improve member outcomes and business outcomes.

We're looking for someone who combines relentless operational execution with the ability to build systems that make the operation dramatically better. You should be equally comfortable jumping into a member escalation, managing an underperforming teammate, analyzing support data, and building a new workflow that eliminates hundreds of future conversations.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage exclusively through delegation. You'll be close to the work, accountable for the details, and expected to continuously improve the organization you're running.

This is a hybrid role based in our Oakland headquarters (4 days/week in office).

OWN THE DAILY PERFORMANCE OF MEMBER SUCCESS

You're accountable for ensuring that every incoming member message is answered each day and that our team consistently delivers fast, thoughtful, and accurate support. Own queue management, response times, service-level agreements, quality standards, and escalation handling. Develop the daily operating rhythms, accountability, and visibility needed to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.




LEAD AND DEVELOP A HIGH-PERFORMING TEAM

Own staffing, scheduling, hiring, coaching, and performance management for our Member Success team. Ensure we have the right coverage throughout the week, establish clear expectations, and hold teammates accountable for results. Build a culture of urgency, ownership, and continuous improvement while developing teammates who can independently solve complex member problems.




USE AI AND DATA TO TRANSFORM OUR OPERATIONS

Lead our efforts to automate member support through Sherlock, our AI-powered member assistant, and other emerging tools. Build dashboards and AI-powered workflows that improve visibility, identify operational bottlenecks, and increase team productivity. Partner with Product and Engineering to expand automation capabilities while maintaining an exceptional member experience.




OWN RENEWALS AND MEMBER RETENTION

Build and continuously improve our membership renewal process. Ensure members receive proactive, timely outreach, identify at-risk members before they churn, and develop scalable workflows that improve retention. Own the operating model, performance metrics, and execution of renewals across the team.




BUILD PROACTIVE MEMBER ENGAGEMENT SYSTEMS

Lead our efforts to move from reactive support to proactive member engagement. Develop and improve our member engagement process, using member behavior, lifecycle milestones, and operational signals to trigger timely outreach and interventions. Build systems that anticipate member needs, improve engagement, and prevent problems before they occur.




SCALE AND IMPROVE HANDYMAN TRANSITIONS

Build scalable workflows, communication strategies, and operational processes that allow us to manage transitions efficiently as we grow. Partner closely with Field Operations to coordinate transitions, minimize disruption, and ensure members feel supported throughout the process.

Inside Sales Account Executive

$120K OTE ($70K Base) • Uncapped Commission • Full Benefits + Equity • Oakland HQ

The opportunity

Every day, homeowners raise their hand to learn about Honey Homes, and our SDR team gets their free walk-thru on the calendar. That's where you come in: you own everything that happens next, turning booked walk-thrus into new members.

You’ll work over phone, text, and email: pre-qualifying and confirming booked walk-thrus, nurturing the not-quite-ready, and re-engaging leads who have gone quiet. Following the walk-thru, you’ll act as a trusted guide—understanding what matters most to the homeowner, recommending the right package, addressing concerns honestly, and confidently asking for the close.

You own the critical bottom of the funnel—turning homeowner interest and a great walk-thru experience into new members and lasting revenue.

A walk-thru is the first in-home appointment where a prospective member meets one of our specialists to review their home, discuss projects and maintenance needs, and learn how Honey Homes works. Walk-thrus that happen, and convert to members, are how this role wins.

About Honey Homes

Honey Homes eliminates the hassle of home upkeep, replacing it with comfort and joy. Our 3,500+ members (homeowners) are each paired with a dedicated handyperson who manages everyday repairs, maintenance, and home improvements throughout the year. All of our handypeople are full-time employees, hired for their technical expertise, service mindset, and integrity. Because the same professional cares for your home consistently, members experience something rare in home services: reliability, trust, and consistently high-quality care.

Behind the scenes, our AI-powered systems help our team operate thoughtfully and efficiently at scale, giving our people better tools to deliver an exceptional homeowner experience. We're backed by Khosla Ventures, Era Ventures, Pear.vc, and the co-founders of DoorDash, Lyft, and Opendoor. We're redefining modern homeownership, and we're just getting started.

What you'll do

  • Pre-qualify and confirm every booked walk-thru so specialists meet informed, ready homeowners

  • Ask smart, empathetic questions to understand each homeowner's needs, assess fit, and set expectations

  • Protect show rates: confirm, remind, and save appointments before they cancel

  • Keep every record clean in HubSpot so the whole team can trust the funnel

  • Follow up after completed walk-thrus to answer questions, handle objections, recommend the right package, and close

  • Nurture the not-quite-ready and re-engage aged, stalled, or ghosted leads

  • Partner daily with SDRs and Walk-Thru Specialists on handoffs, debriefs, and stuck deals

  • Identify patterns in homeowner objections, lead quality, and lost deals, and turn those insights into improvements across Marketing, SDR, and Walk-Thru operations

  • Use AI tools and automation to move faster, personalize follow-up, and help make our playbook better

  • Flex onto inbound calls and fresh leads when volume spikes. Our SDR team owns first touch, but speed to lead is a team sport here

Why this role is unique

A high-intent, warm pipeline. Marketing and our SDR team generate demand and book walk-thrus, so you can focus most of your energy on qualification, conversion, and follow-through. When the business needs it, though, everyone jumps in—including on fresh inbound leads.

You're the closer. This is the revenue seat on the inside team, with commission tied directly to the new members and revenue you bring in.

Technology that makes you better. Automated queues, intelligent follow-up, and AI-assisted tools help you respond faster, stay organized, and spend more time building trust with homeowners. You'll use these tools daily and help us improve them.

Uncapped earnings and real career upside. Top performers earn above OTE and can grow into senior roles as we scale.

What we're looking for

You can sell. 2+ years of sales experience in a high-velocity environment, ideally closing over the phone. SaaS, home services, real estate, or membership businesses are a plus.

You're fast. Same-day follow-through is instinct for you, not a policy you comply with.

You're a strong communicator. You build trust quickly over phone and text, understand what matters to the homeowner, and are comfortable recommending the right package and confidently asking for the close.

You run a tight pipeline. Organized and self-accountable. Follow-ups happen when you said they would, and your CRM reflects reality. HubSpot experience is a plus.

You're resilient. You handle no's well and keep your energy through long follow-up cycles.

You use technology as leverage. You're comfortable using AI and automation to prepare faster, personalize follow-up, and keep opportunities moving—without losing the human touch.

You act like an owner. You don't wait for the perfect script, lead routing rule, or automated workflow. You spot what's slowing down conversion, take action, share what you're learning, and help fix the system—not just work within it.

What success looks like in 90 days

  • You're consistently meeting or approaching ramped show-rate, conversion, and new-revenue targets

  • You deeply understand our homeowners, packages, most common objections, and strongest conversion signals

  • Specialists walk into homes where homeowners are informed, qualified, and prepared for the visit

  • Every viable opportunity has a clear next step, and no lead quietly falls through the cracks

  • Your HubSpot pipeline accurately reflects reality and supports reliable forecasting

  • You've improved at least one meaningful part of our qualification, follow-up, or closing playbook based on patterns from your first 100+ conversations

Compensation and benefits

  • On-target earnings: $120,000 per year ($70,000 base plus uncapped commission on new revenue)

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision for employees

  • 401(k), FSA, paid parental leave, and paid time off

A few things to know

This is a full-time, in-office role at our Oakland HQ.

If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd love to meet you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. Women and under-represented minorities are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Member Operations Associate (NY/NJ)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Honey Homes

Honey Homes is reimagining homeownership through a membership that makes maintaining a home effortless. Our members have a dedicated handyman who proactively cares for their home year-round, helping prevent small problems from becoming expensive ones.

The Member Operations Associate is the evolution of traditional customer support. Rather than simply responding to members, you'll own member outcomes while helping improve the systems, tools, and processes that power the entire member experience.

Every day you'll work directly with homeowners, helping them solve problems and coordinating across teams to ensure they're taken care of. But that's only part of the job. You'll also identify recurring issues, improve workflows, leverage AI to eliminate repetitive work, and partner across the business to make Honey Homes better for both our members and our internal teams.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys helping people, loves solving problems, thinks in systems rather than one-off solutions, and is excited about using AI and technology to fundamentally change how customer operations are run.

Please note the shift for this role is Sunday - Thursday.

What You'll Do

Own the member journey

Own member issues from beginning to end across app messaging, phone, SMS, and email. You'll coordinate across teams, communicate proactively, remove blockers, and ensure every member feels taken care of throughout their experience. Solving the immediate problem is expected. Owning the outcome is the standard.

Solve today's problems while eliminating tomorrow's

Every recurring member issue should trigger a deeper question: Why did this happen? How do we prevent it? Can we automate it? Should we document it? Does another team need to know? Your job isn't complete when the ticket is resolved. It's complete when you've helped reduce the likelihood another member experiences the same problem.

Use AI to multiply your impact

Leverage AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to eliminate repetitive work, improve documentation, automate workflows, and increase your effectiveness. We expect everyone on the team to actively experiment with new tools, test ideas, and continuously improve how work gets done.

Improve the member experience

Member Success sits at the center of the member experience. You'll partner closely with Sales, Walkthrough Specialists, Field Operations, Billing, Product, Marketing, Recruiting, and other teams to surface trends, advocate for change, and help implement better ways of working. Our responsibility is the entire member journey, not just the conversations that reach our queue.

Own a functional area

In addition to supporting members, every Member Operations Associate owns an area of the business. This might include onboarding, messaging, knowledge management, phone operations, AI tools, NPS, reporting, documentation, or another operational focus area. You'll become the team's subject matter expert and be responsible for continuously improving how that area operates over time.

Operate with high agency

We don't wait for someone else to identify problems. We expect every teammate to proactively find opportunities, propose solutions, build improvements, measure their impact, and share what they've learned. Curiosity, ownership, systems thinking, and continuous improvement aren't nice-to-haves—they're core expectations of the role.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you'll:

  • Deliver consistently exceptional experiences for Honey Homes members.

  • Develop expertise in your operational ownership area and drive measurable improvements.

  • Identify recurring member issues and help implement solutions that reduce future support volume.

  • Build AI-powered workflows and automations that improve efficiency across the team.

  • Create documentation, SOPs, and knowledge resources that make the organization more effective.

  • Become a trusted cross-functional partner who proactively identifies opportunities to improve operations and follows through on delivering results.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for people who care deeply about helping customers but are equally motivated to improve the systems behind the customer experience.

The strongest candidates will bring many of the following:

  • 2+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, operations, hospitality, or another customer-facing role.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • High agency and a bias toward ownership - you don't wait to be asked to solve problems.

  • Curiosity and a desire to continuously improve how work gets done.

  • Comfort learning and using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies to improve productivity.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • The ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams.

  • An interest in process improvement, operational excellence, and building scalable systems.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment is a plus.

The compensation for this role is $72,000 plus equity. Because it's part of a structured program, we offer the same compensation package to everyone in the program and therefore is non-negotiable.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. Women and under-represented minorities are encouraged to apply.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Honey Homes

Honey Homes is reimagining homeownership through a membership that makes maintaining a home effortless. Our members have a dedicated handyman who proactively cares for their home year-round, helping prevent small problems from becoming expensive ones.

Our members increasingly bring us bigger jobs: exterior repaints, deck and fence rebuilds, siding and dry-rot repair, bathroom updates, built-ins, etc. Our Large Projects team scopes, prices, and delivers that work. The Project Scoping Specialist owns the front half of every one of those projects: the conversation with the member, the scope, and the estimate. Within the funnel, an SDR or walkthrough-booker gets the scoping call on the calendar, the scoper owns everything from the scoping call to a signed yes (scope, estimate, and member follow-up), and member success owns scheduling and billing.

Every day you'll meet homeowners on video, walk their project with them, and turn what you learn into a complete, accurate estimate that you build and submit yourself. You'll decide when a project can be priced remotely and when it needs a visit or a specialist, keep every project moving through our pipeline, and hand accepted jobs to our crews with everything they need to do the work right the first time.

This is an ideal role for someone who has built and fixed things for a living, understands how homes actually work, genuinely enjoys homeowners, and wants to use modern tools, including AI, to make estimating faster and more accurate than it has ever been.

This role is hybrid 3-4 days per week in our Oakland headquarters, or remote for non-CA candidates.

What You'll Do

Run the scoping consultation

You'll run our virtual scoping calls: 15-minute video consultations, recorded and prepared. Before each call you'll review the member's photos, prior messages, handyperson notes, and intake answers on budget and timeline, so you never ask a member to repeat themselves. On the call you capture two things: the scope, and the member's intent. What they actually want and why, their timeline, and what is driving or holding the decision. You narrow to one scope, define what is in and what is out, and count and measure the quantities that drive price rather than taking them on faith.

Build and submit the estimate

You turn each call into a complete estimate within 24 hours: written scope, quantities, labor hours, crew and days, materials, and price using our pricing framework, submitted through our estimate tools. Our field lead reviews every estimate for scope and quality before it goes to the member; you turn revisions around the same day. The goal is an estimate in the member's hands within a day of their call, approved on the first pass, and same day when the project is simple enough to price live. When a few variables are still open, a tight price range with the drivers spelled out keeps the member moving, and you firm it up to a final number once they decide to proceed.

Decide the next step

Not every call ends in an estimate, and that's expected. You'll decide, quickly and with a written reason, whether a project should be quoted remotely, routed to an in-person visit, referred to a partner or specialist, or declined as not a fit. When a visit is needed, you work with our member success team to get it scheduled within 24 hours. When a project isn't a fit, the member hears it clearly and kindly.

Keep the pipeline moving

You own the scoping stages of our project pipeline in our CRM. Every lead has a next step, an owner, and a date. No completed scoping call sits without an estimate for more than a business day, and stalled projects get flagged before anyone has to ask.

Own the member relationship and win the work

You're the member's point of contact from the scoping call to a signed yes. You build their confidence in the project, walk them through the estimate and the tradeoffs, and help them make the calls that unlock a decision: materials, timing, and scope. When a member is on the fence, you run the follow-up directly, surface what's holding them back, and help them move. You get good projects booked the way a trusted builder who runs their own business would: not by pushing, but by making a confusing project feel clear and doable. Member success owns scheduling and billing; the follow-up to close is yours.

Set the crew up to succeed

When an estimate is accepted, you hand it off with a job brief: scope, measurements, materials, member preferences, access notes, and photos, attached to the crew's task before day one. What was promised on the call is what gets built, and the crew starts without a phone call.

Use AI to multiply your impact

You'll use AI tools like Claude to structure your call notes, draft scopes from transcripts, and turn recurring project types into templates. We expect everyone on the team to actively experiment with new tools, test ideas, and continuously improve how work gets done, including emerging video and measurement tools that make remote scoping more accurate.

Build the playbook

Every call you log feeds a scoping playbook. You'll spot recurring project patterns, help create standard pricing and scoping templates, and push toward a world where routine jobs are quoted in minutes and only the complex ones need a specialist's eye. We don't wait for someone else to identify problems; we expect you to find them, propose fixes, and follow through.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you'll:

  • Run every virtual scoping consultation for the Large Projects team and be the person members and teammates trust to get the scope right.

  • Deliver a complete estimate within 24 hours of every call, with most estimates approved by our field lead on the first pass.

  • Make clear, well-reasoned routing decisions, so in-person visits, partner referrals, and declines happen within a day instead of lingering.

  • Keep the scoping pipeline clean and current, with no completed call waiting on an estimate and no lead without a next step.

  • Hand off accepted jobs with briefs complete enough that crews start on day one without questions, and estimates that hold up against actual hours.

  • Build the templates, standard pricing inputs, and AI-assisted workflows that let the team quote standard projects in minutes.

  • Become a trusted partner to member success, our field lead, and our program lead, with a measurable effect on call-to-estimate turnaround, first-pass approval rate, estimate acceptance rate, and revenue booked.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who has real construction experience, understands how homes are maintained and repaired, and is genuinely energized by talking with homeowners.

The strongest candidates will bring many of the following:

  • 3+ years of hands-on residential construction, remodeling, handyman, or home-improvement experience (required). You can look at photos and a video walkthrough of a deck, a fence line, a bathroom, or a stretch of siding and see the tasks, the sequence, the materials, and the surprises hiding behind them.

  • Working knowledge of home maintenance and repair: how common projects are done, what they take, and what goes wrong.

  • Experience producing written scopes or estimates with labor hours and materials, ideally including photo- or video-based estimating.

  • A customer-forward style. You put homeowners at ease on camera, ask good questions, listen for what they want and why, and represent Honey Homes with warmth and credibility in a 15-minute window.

  • Comfort owning the outcome, not just the estimate. You can build a homeowner's confidence, handle questions on process and price, and help an undecided member reach a confident yes, then follow up until the project is booked. Consultative, not high-pressure.

  • Outstanding written communication. Your scopes leave nothing to interpretation and your notes let a crew start without a phone call.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to keep a dozen open projects straight while holding a 24-hour turnaround.

  • Decisiveness in ambiguity: you can tell quickly which projects need a visit, a specialist, or a polite no, and explain why.

  • High agency and a bias toward ownership. You follow projects through to a decision and don't wait to be asked to fix what's slow.

  • Comfort learning and using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT, plus a CRM and estimating software, to improve accuracy and speed.

  • Having run your own trade or contracting business, where you scoped, priced, and sold the work yourself, is a strong plus. Experience at a fast-growing, operationally complex company, or at a small contractor where you wore several hats, also counts.

Why This Role Is Different

Most estimating roles measure success by the number of estimates you produce.

This role measures success by how fast and how accurately a member gets an answer they can say yes to, and by how much of the work gets built exactly as promised.

You'll certainly spend your days scoping projects and building estimates, but you'll also shape how a growing team scopes remotely, prices consistently, and hands work to the field. The playbook, the templates, and the tools you build will outlast any single project.

If you're excited to combine real construction know-how with a customer-first mindset, embrace AI as part of your daily work, and help define how Honey Homes takes on bigger jobs, we'd love to meet you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. Women and under-represented minorities are encouraged to apply.

Senior Manager, Product Marketing & Lifecycle

Location: Oakland, CA; Hybrid


About Honey Homes

Honey Homes is transforming how homeowners take care of their homes.

We pair homeowners with a dedicated, full-time craftsman who gets to know their home over time, handling everyday repairs, preventive maintenance, projects, and all the things that otherwise sit on the to-do list. Behind the scenes, our technology and AI-powered systems help our team deliver a dramatically easier, more proactive home-care experience.

Today, thousands of homeowners across the Bay Area, Los Angeles, Dallas, Austin, Chicago, and beyond trust Honey Homes to care for their homes.

We’re building a new category of relationship-based home care—and we’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Marketing & Lifecycle to help more homeowners discover Honey Homes, understand why it’s different, and experience its value.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a builder who sits at the intersection of product marketing, lifecycle, and customer marketing.

You’ll own lifecycle strategy across the prospect and early member journey, using audience insights, strong messaging, and thoughtful experimentation to turn interest into action. You’ll also build programs that turn our happiest members into advocates, bring their stories to life, and support key product marketing initiatives across the company.

This isn’t a role where you hand a strategy to someone else to execute. You’ll identify opportunities, design programs, execute flawlessly, and measure results. You’ll proactively use AI to help with everything, and demonstrate rigor and attention to detail and accuracy.

Your north star is simple: help more homeowners discover Honey Homes, understand why it’s different, and experience its value.

What You’ll Own

Build a prospect lifecycle engine that generates meaningful growth

Own lifecycle programs from MQL to new member: strategy, segmentation, messaging and content, build, automation, experimentation, measurement, and iteration. You’ll be the hands-on owner of our email and SMS tooling and able to ship without waiting on Engineering.

You’ll build and continually improve programs across the prospect journey, including:

  • MQL nurture for new and existing leads, personalized by market and acquisition source

  • Walk-through reschedule and cancellation recovery

  • Follow-up for homeowners who complete a walk-through but haven’t yet joined

  • Sign-up abandonment recovery

  • Waitlist activation and new-market launch communications

  • Automated outbound to local groups and potential partners

  • Newsletters, seasonal campaigns, incentives, and tentpole moments

You’ll launch 2–3 new programs or meaningful experiments each month and build the reporting needed to understand what’s working, diagnose what isn’t, and decide what to test next.

Turn happy members into advocates—and their experiences into proof

Our members and their communities can be some of our most powerful marketers. You’ll help build scalable programs that make it easy for them to spread the word—and create a steady pipeline of real customer stories that bring the Honey Homes experience to life.

You’ll:

  • Build and scale our member ambassador program, from identifying potential ambassadors through personalized outreach, communications, incentives, and payouts

  • Use AI and automation to make member outreach increasingly personalized and scalable

  • Interview members, uncover compelling stories, and turn them into content for our website, lifecycle, Sales and Member Success, paid campaigns, social, and PR

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of relevant, seasonal, and topical content that showcases Honey Homes’ expertise, members, and craftspeople

  • Support local content and PR opportunities that help Honey Homes show up authentically in the communities we serve

What Might Make This Role Challenging

Honey Homes is still building the playbook.

There won’t always be an existing campaign to optimize, a perfect brief, or someone telling you exactly what to do next. Some of the highest-impact programs you’ll own don’t exist yet.

You’ll need to be equally comfortable thinking strategically and getting into the details: writing an SMS in the morning, digging into funnel data at lunch, interviewing a member or designing a new ambassador experiment in the afternoon, and figuring out how AI could automate half of it tomorrow.

If you love creating the playbook rather than following one, you’ll probably love this role.

What We’re Looking For

You’re a builder. You don’t wait for perfect instructions. You’ve taken ideas from 0→1, tested them quickly, learned from what happened, and made them better. Ambiguity gives you energy rather than slowing you down.

You’re AI-first. You use AI to build, test, automate, and improve programs—not just to draft copy. You’re excited by what’s newly possible in personalization and experimentation and constantly look for ways technology can make a small team dramatically more effective.

You love storytelling and personalized communications. You find the story that makes someone feel understood and ready to act. You combine strong writing instincts with customer and behavioral data to deliver the right message, through the right channel, at the right moment.

You’re creatively restless. You’re constantly asking, “What else could we try?” You bring bold, unconventional ideas and aren’t afraid to break the normal playbook when there’s a better way.

You’re analytical and experimental. You’re as comfortable digging into funnel performance as you are writing copy. You form hypotheses, measure results, and use what you learn to decide what to do next.

You prioritize relentlessly. There will always be more good ideas than time. You identify the work that matters most, focus on it, and get it shipped.

You communicate clearly. You’re an exceptional writer and storyteller, and you create clarity around what you’re doing, why you’re doing it, what happened, and what comes next.

You act like an owner. You care about the outcome, not just your piece of it. You do what’s right for future members, current members, and the company—even when it means stepping outside your job description.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience across product marketing, lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, consumer marketing, or a combination of these disciplines

  • Demonstrated experience owning lifecycle programs across email and/or SMS, including segmentation, automation, experimentation, and measurement

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with examples of communications or campaigns you’ve personally created

  • Strong analytical instincts and experience using funnel and behavioral data to identify opportunities and improve conversion

  • Experience building or scaling programs from 0→1 rather than solely operating mature programs

  • Comfortable working hands-on in marketing and analytics tools rather than relying exclusively on agencies or other teams for execution

  • Excited to use AI and automation as part of your everyday workflow

  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or similarly high-ownership environment strongly preferred

  • Consumer, marketplace, membership/subscription, local-services, or home-services experience is a plus, but not required

    Compensation: $160,000-$190,000 / year, plus equity, and full health benefits.

     

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. Women and under-represented minorities are encouraged to apply.
